# mvstmt: test isTerm select with complex case bodies
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(ch1, ch2, ch3 chan int) {
	x := 0
	// BEGIN
	select {
	case v := <-ch1:
		if v > 0 {
			x = v
		}
		return
	case ch2 <- 1:
		for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
			x = i
		}
		return
	default:
		for range ch3 {
			break
		}
		return
	}
	// END
	_ = x
}
